correctness.rationale: For q>=3, the six support/annihilator classes have multiplicities a=(q-1)^2, b=q-1 and triangular-prism quotient, all independent false-twin classes. Two white vertices in one class are a permanent fort; with at most one, a blue representative is guaranteed in every class and forcing is exactly the quotient label-peeling process. Complete quotient census: all twenty 3-label subsets force, exactly twelve of fifteen 4-label subsets force, and no 5-label subset; the 4-label class-weight distribution (3,6,3) gives 3ab(a+b)^2 leading coefficient and the full five-term enumerator. The prism quotient adjacency has rational rank 4; its blow-up is a real symmetric graph-pattern rank-4 matrix, and M<=Z proves matching lower bound. The singleton q=2 boundary is the triangular prism with 14u^3+15u^4+6u^5+u^6 and an explicit rank-3 Gram witness. Direct independent exact graph/census checks for q=2,3 reproduced coefficients; rank of six-type quotient checked independently. These finite checks are corroboration, not the all-q proof.
